OpenAI CFO Discusses AI for Chip Design and Ad Models

OpenAI Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar has stated that the company is offering artificial intelligence solutions for chip design, highlighting a cost advantage over open-source alternatives. Friar also described potential advertising models for ChatGPT, likening them to a combination of Google and Meta's approaches. The company is exploring AI's application in hardware development and new revenue streams for its conversational AI.
